The matter is listed today under the caption for being mentioned.
2. It is brought to the notice of this Court that while disposing the above said writ petition, this Court has granted liberty to the petitioner to approach appellate authority.
The said portion has not shown in the order dated 12.09.2025.

Therefore, this Court is inclined to modify the para No.3 of the order dated 12.09.2025 in the above said writ petition as follows:
'' 3.
Recording the above submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to work out his remedy before the appellate authority in the manner known to law.
The period pending before this Court is excluded for the purpose of limitation.
No costs.
Consequently.
Connected miscellaneous petition is closed. ''
3. Except the above modification, remaining portion of the order dated 12.09.2025 shall stand unaltered.
